items.headline: Big 12 admits error in Notre Dame-BYU, says Irish had time for one more play
items.description: The Big 12 said officials incorrectly ended Saturday night's game between BYU and Notre Dame and that the Irish should have had another second on the clock to run a final play.

items.headline: Kalani Sitake, 'a BYU fan first,' emotional after Cougars' upset of Notre Dame
items.description: With a defensive stop that concluded in the end zone on the game's final play, No. 8 BYU outlasted No. 2 Notre Dame to preserve a riveting 28-24 victory, the Fighting Irish's first loss of the season and a win that moved to Cougars to 6-0.
